header.title: The process you trust — now at AI speed
header.description: The fundamentals haven't changed: understand, plan, prove, build, iterate. What changed is how fast each step moves when engineers lead a human + agent team.

phases.title: Talk ideas
phases.description: We listen to your goals, users and constraints, and challenge assumptions early.

phases.title: Overall plan
phases.description: An initial high-level plan: scope, architecture direction, risks and priorities.

phases.title: Proof of concept
phases.description: A working POC validates the riskiest ideas before you commit to the build.

phases.title: MVP plan in sprints
phases.description: We define the MVP and split it into short sprints with clear acceptance criteria.

phases.title: Sprint deliverables
phases.description: Every sprint ends with a reviewed, working deliverable you can see and use.

phases.title: Iterate to results
phases.description: After the MVP we keep iterating, tuning the solution to the business results you need.

note: Still iterative by design — we adapt to your needs as they evolve, sprint after sprint.
